authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11567 vārdala gives Punjabi baddal and neighboring bādal cloud. Awan badl directly fits this cloud family; the short vowel and cluster are retained. Exact survey form badl is preserved.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 11567 vārdala gives Punjabi baddal and neighboring bādal cloud. Awan badl directly fits this cloud family; the short vowel and cluster are retained. Exact survey form badl is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9051 phala gives Lahnda/Punjabi phal fruit. Awan pal fruit is compared in that family with deaspiration retained; the exact regional transmission remains open. Exact survey form pal is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3193 kīṭa gives Lahnda/Punjabi kīṛā insect and kīṛī ant, plus Hindi kīṛī ant. Awan kīṛa ant and Goj qiṛī are compared with this family; the ant sense and q versus k are retained as regional details. Exact survey form kīṛa is preserved.
